articles.title: Scientists Test a Nuclear Plan to Stop a Giant Asteroid
articles.summary: Scientists simulated a nuclear blast above a large asteroid to push it off course or break it apart when warning time is very short.

articles.title: Five Spooky Sky Targets to Spot This Halloween
articles.summary: Five naked-eye sky targets, from the Pleiades to slow Taurid meteors, are worth watching around Halloween.

articles.title: Switzerland Has Lost Nearly a Fifth of Its Glacier Ice in Five Years
articles.summary: Swiss glaciers lost over 5 percent of their ice in 2026, adding up to nearly 20 percent lost in five years.
